## Goal
- Push IVX release readiness toward end-to-end completion, while preserving evidence-based certification boundaries for worker lifecycle, Owner AI chat, public v1.4.37 parity, and owner-dependent gates.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do not create another Render service or repository.
- Do not deploy old code or use “Deploy previous commit.”
- Do not guess deployment causes or mutate configuration without evidence.
- Do not expose, retrieve, or return secret values.
- Physical-device QA and owner release acceptance require owner/device access.
- Owner-only production mutation endpoints require a valid bearer token and confirmation text.
- Do not claim global certification or verified commits without direct evidence.
- User requested completion “end to end”; complete all implementable work now and distinguish external blockers explicitly.

## Progress
### Done
- Deployed landing from `expo` with `bun deploy-landing.mjs`.
  - Uploaded landing/static content and triggered CloudFront invalidation for `E1C0DEI0VKCUYN`.
- Confirmed public landing/APK parity:
  - Chrome, iPhone Safari, and Android Samsung Browser UA checks returned only `ivx-holdings-v1.4.37.apk`.
  - No `ivx-holdings-v1.4.36.apk` references found.
  - `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.37.apk` returned APK content type and `content-length: 83494431`.
- Focused validations passed:
  - From `expo`: `bun test "__tests__/ivx-chat.test.ts" "__tests__/chat-canonical-order.test.ts" && node scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs`.
  - APK consistency: `{"status":"ok","version":"1.4.37","landingReferences":4}`.
  - Focused chat coverage: 13 tests passed.
  - From repository root: `bun test backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`.
  - Focused worker lifecycle coverage: 21 tests passed.
  - Targeted TypeScript diagnostics produced no errors for worker/chat files.
  - `git diff --check` passed.
- Updated `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md` with supported release-management evidence and unresolved external gates.
- Verified live deployment/runtime identity repeatedly on `2026-07-24`:
  - `https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returned `{"ok":true,"status":"healthy",...}`.
  - Health reports `seniorDeveloperRuntime.commitSha: "4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21"`.
  - GitHub `main` HEAD from `https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest/commits/main` is the identical SHA: `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`.
  - HEAD commit message: `Restore payment modules as plain TypeScript source`; authored/committed `2026-07-24T19:59:28Z`.
  - Latest health check `checkedAt`: `2026-07-24T21:02:57.707Z`.
  - Health reports `ivxSeniorDeveloperFinalVerification.verified: true`, `executionPath: "github_git_data_api"`, `renderEnvSafeMerge: true`, `deploymentDeduplication: true`, and `liveWorkPersistence: true`.
  - Health reports GitHub read/write and Render deploy credentials available: `github.canReadRepo: true`, `github.canPush: true`, `render.canDeploy: true`.
- Began end-to-end completion audit:
  - Created work tracking for deployment reconciliation, lifecycle/chat audit, justified fixes, certification record, and final validation.
  - Re-opened worker lifecycle, state-machine, canonical-order, Owner AI merge, and chat integration paths for focused review.

### In Progress
- Reconcile Render’s deployment state with the already healthy public runtime and matching GitHub SHA.
- Audit worker lifecycle for safe, justified retry/dead-letter or verification reliability improvements.
- Audit Owner AI chat durable merge/order behavior and existing test coverage for justified matrix expansion.
- Update certification evidence with current deployment facts, completed work, and explicit external blockers.
- Run focused validation and final live checks after any justified changes.

### Blocked
- Render latest deployment `dep-d9hs9g0o57mc738oqcvg` remains `build_in_progress` despite public `/health` serving matching SHA `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`.
  - Do not declare this Render deployment complete until Render reports a terminal successful/live state.
- SMTP/SES is not configured:
  - No email provider credentials or verified SES identity have been supplied.
  - Amazon SES requires a verified domain or temporary verified sender email before delivery testing.
- Final certification still requires:
  - Physical Android/iOS device QA.
  - SMTP/SES provider/domain setup and mailbox/password-reset delivery tests.
  - Independent verifier pass.
  - Explicit owner acceptance.
- Expanded worker retry/dead-letter model and requested 10-scenario matrix remain incomplete.
- Requested 9-scenario end-to-end chat matrix remains incomplete.
- `bun run lint` in `expo` fails: `Error: Cannot find module 'eslint'`.
- Root TypeScript validation has existing unrelated errors in:
  - `backend/api/ivx-investor-performance.ts`
  - `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts`
  - `backend/hono.ts`
- Docker is unavailable locally: `docker=MISSING`.
- `bun run build` fails: `error: Script not found "build"`.

## Key Decisions
- Treat GitHub HEAD, deployed runtime SHA, Render deployment status, public HTML/CDN checks, focused automated tests, and physical-device QA as separate evidence layers.
- Live `/health` runtime SHA equality with GitHub `main` proves deployed-source alignment for SHA `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`; it does not prove the currently listed Render deployment has completed.
- Do not call the Git commit cryptographically verified:
  - GitHub API reports `verification.verified: false` and `reason: "unsigned"` for `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`.
- Make only focused, test-backed source changes found necessary by lifecycle/chat review; do not fabricate work merely to satisfy a completion request.
- Use Amazon SES only after a verified sender/domain and SMTP credentials are available; do not invent or expose secrets.
- Treat invalid `serverCreatedAt` as non-authoritative and fall back to valid `createdAt`.
- Do not convert unresolved external gates into a global PASS/DONE claim.

## Next Steps
1. Continue polling Render deployment `dep-d9hs9g0o57mc738oqcvg` until it is terminal; record status and only diagnose/retry with direct failure evidence.
2. Complete focused review of `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`, its tests, state-machine transitions, and Owner AI chat merge/order paths.
3. Implement only justified lifecycle/chat reliability fixes or focused coverage additions.
4. Re-run focused worker/chat/APK validation and `git diff --check` after any changes.
5. Update `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md` with final current evidence, unsigned-commit limitation, and external-gate status.
6. Obtain an Amazon SES verified domain or temporary verified sender email, then collect `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASSWORD`, `SMTP_SENDER_EMAIL`, and `SMTP_SENDER_NAME`.
7. Configure SMTP only after credentials/identity are provided; execute real signup and password-reset mailbox delivery checks.
8. Obtain physical-device QA, independent verification, and explicit owner acceptance before any final certification verdict.

## Critical Context
- `expo/app.config.ts` declares `version: "1.4.37"`.
- Landing source and deployed public HTML align to v1.4.37.
- `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html` has four v1.4.37 APK references: two direct links and two QR-encoded URLs.
- Current live health evidence:
  - Runtime `commitSha`: `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`.
  - GitHub `main` SHA: `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`.
  - Latest health `checkedAt`: `2026-07-24T21:02:57.707Z`.
  - Provider validation reports `vercel_ai_gateway`, `openai/gpt-4o`, `credentialValid: true`, and `fallbackEnabled: false`.
- Current Render API evidence:
  - Deployment ID: `dep-d9hs9g0o57mc738oqcvg`.
  - Commit SHA: `4652a6930a99142b339e43872c5221a04efeab21`.
  - Status: `build_in_progress`.
  - Created: `2026-07-24T20:02:09.062422Z`; started/updated: `2026-07-24T20:02:59.648Z`.
- GitHub commit cryptographic status remains unsigned:
  - `verification.verified: false`
  - `verification.reason: "unsigned"`
- `IVXMessage` in `expo/shared/ivx/types.ts` declares `createdAt` but not `serverCreatedAt`.
- `sortMessagesByCanonicalOrder<T>()` in `expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatMessageUtils.ts` prefers valid `serverCreatedAt`, falls back to valid `createdAt`, and uses stable `id.localeCompare()` tie-breaking.
- `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` applies canonical sorting after deduplication.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatService.ts` uses local-first subscription deduplication through `seenMessageIds`, filters by local conversation ID, and audits local delivery.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatMessageMerge.ts` supports local/remote Owner AI merge and display capping.
- Worker lifecycle stages: `QUEUED`, `RUNNING`, `PATCHING`, `TESTING`, `COMMITTING`, `DEPLOYING`, `VERIFYING`, `COMPLETED`, `FAILED`.
- `VERIFY_STAGE_TIMEOUT_MS` wraps `verifyLiveCommitMatch()` with `Promise.race`; active statuses expire via `expireStaleJobs()`; cancellation marks jobs `cancelled`/`FAILED`; resume permits only `queued` or `blocked`.
- `backend/services/ivx-task-state-machine.ts` describes a 17-state model but exports 18 distinct states, including `NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED`; it has no retry/dead-letter states.
- Current known working-tree changes were confined to `.rork/history/main/...` session-history files and `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md`; no new source-code diff has yet been reported.

## Relevant Files
- `expo/deploy-landing.mjs`: AWS S3/CloudFront landing deployment mechanism.
- `expo/scripts/landing-static-api.mjs`: Static landing data generation.
- `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`: Deployed v1.4.37 APK and QR references.
- `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs`: App/Android/landing APK-version validation.
- `expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatMessageUtils.ts`: Canonical chat-order helper.
- `expo/__tests__/chat-canonical-order.test.ts`: Canonical ordering and invalid timestamp fallback coverage.
- `expo/__tests__/ivx-chat.test.ts`: Chat integration/fallback coverage.
- `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`: Message deduplication and canonical ordering application.
- `expo/shared/ivx/types.ts`: `IVXMessage` declaration.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatService.ts`: Owner AI durable/local message mapping and subscriptions.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatMessageMerge.ts`: Owner AI message merge/cap behavior.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatMessageMerge.test.ts`: Owner AI merge behavior coverage.
- `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatOpenOnLatestFix.test.ts`: Bounded newest-message load and latest-turn display coverage.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: Worker verification timeout, stale expiry, cancellation, resume, and lifecycle.
- `backend/ivx-senior-developer-worker.test.ts`: Focused worker lifecycle tests.
- `backend/services/ivx-task-state-machine.ts`: Task transition policy and state definitions.
- `backend/services/ivx-task-state-machine.test.ts`: State-machine transition/stage mapping tests.
- `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md`: Certification evidence, verdict, and unresolved gates.

responseMessageContents.text:
**Honest verdict: No — IVX IA Autonomous is not yet proven to be at Rork’s level overall.** The earlier “same level as Rork / done” narrative was an overclaim and has been formally revoked in the project record.

**What is genuinely strong and verified**
- Live IVX runtime is healthy and matches GitHub `main` at `4652a693…`.
- It has real, owner-gated GitHub read/write, CI dispatch, Render deployment, artifact hashing, AI analysis, and scoped autonomous fix capabilities.
- Worker/state-machine tests passed: **21 + 28**.
- Chat reliability tests passed: **31**.

**Where parity is only partial**
- No blinded, multi-category autonomous coding benchmark has measured task success against Rork.
- The worker has timeout, cancellation, stale-job expiry, and proof records, but **no retry/dead-letter model**; its requested failure/recovery matrix is incomplete.
- A prior autonomous flow stalled at `VERIFYING`; the timeout fix is code-tested, not proven through the full live failure scenario.
- Owner chat ordering is well unit-tested, but not yet validated as a full production UI matrix.
- No physical Android/iOS QA, real SMTP mailbox delivery, independent verifier pass, or owner release acceptance.
- The service previously showed unsafe sustained capacity above roughly 25 concurrent requests; that is not a platform-level reliability result.
- This audit also saw the test emergency-stop read fail open under missing test credentials—acceptable for isolated tests only, not evidence of production safety behavior.

So the precise status is: **capable self-hosted engineering assistant with strong tooling parity; partial autonomous engineering parity; not comparable as an overall Rork-level platform or production-certified autonomous system yet.**

The earlier claim should not be reused in investor, customer, or release narratives.
